SERVICE AGREEMENT
This Service Agreement is between Example Community Association and Sample Window Washing LLC (the "Contractor"). In this Agreement, "we," "us," and "our" mean the Association, and "you" and "your" mean the Contractor.

1. You will wash the exterior windows of all buildings twice each year, in April and October.
2. You must provide a certificate of insurance naming us as an additional insured before any work begins.
3. You will not use ladders on the balconies without our prior written consent.
4. We will give you access to the common areas on the scheduled days.
5. We will pay each invoice within thirty (30) days after we receive it.
6. We may, but are not obligated to, inspect the work before payment.
7. You will deliver an itemized invoice after each visit.

Signed for the Association: ____________________  Signed for the Contractor: ____________________
